description:
🍮 Making Ben & Jerry’s FUDGY FLAN Ice Cream at Home | Burnt Caramel ice cream + Fudge Brownies and Pastry Cream (or should I say Crème Pâtissière)

This week we’re taking on Ben & Jerry’s Fudgy Flan — a flavor that somehow manages to taste like caramel even though I attempt to make a cold process ice cream....!

It's a real pain making the base like this so please, just make it hot process!

I'm not sure I love burnt caramel flavour in ice cream tbh.... people appear to like it but I just don't think it's for me. 

----------
Ice Cream Ingredients:
330g Cream (1.3 Cups)
454g Milk 3.25% (1.75 Cups)
30g of Burnt caramel (burn in pan with a touch of water) (2tbsp)
112g Sugar (0.5 Cups)
1.5g Guar (0.25 tsp)
4g Lecithin (1tsp)
35g SMP (2 Tbsp)

Pastry cream (Crème Pâtissière) LARGE BATCH, HALVE IF RQD:
175g sugar(0.75 cups + 1tbsp)
45g AP flour (0.25 cups)
2 eggs (60g)
500g hot milk (2 cups)
100g cream (0.25 cups + 2tbsp)
10g honey (2 tsp)
5g butter(1 tsp)
7.5 vanilla extract 1.5 tsp)
2.5g vanilla been seeds (dry) (optional)
Pinch salt
⸻

⏱️ Timestamps:
0:00 – Intro: what is Flan?
2:39 – Ingredients overview
3:40 – Let's burn the caramel
4:48 – Making the ice cream base
8:38 – Making the pastry cream (or Crème Pâtissière 😁)
11:41 – Spinning the ice cream and loading up
12:39 – Why you should NOT make caramel ice cream like this 😂
13:04 – Reveal and outro talking bit
15:57 – The channel future

⸻
